panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Distinct workflow runs (forge.ai.run.id) with any span in the range. A run that continues in a new trace stays one run. The trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql:
WITH ai AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, TraceId, SpanName, StatusCode, StatusMessage, Duration,
         SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] AS op, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] AS is_call, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool' AS is_tool, (StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != 'canceled') AS failed,
         if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model']) AS model, if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system']) AS provider,
         toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']) AS in_tok, toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) AS out_tok, toUInt64OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read_input_tokens'])) AS cache_read_tok,
         toFloat64OrNull(if(SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'] != '', SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'], SpanAttributes['reliant.cost_usd'])) AS cost, SpanAttributes['forge.ai.workflow.name'] AS workflow, SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'] AS run_id,
         SpanAttributes['error.type'] AS error_type, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] AS tool,
         SpanAttributes['user.id'] AS user_id, SpanAttributes['org.id'] AS org_id
  FROM otel_traces
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND (SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] != '' OR SpanAttributes['forge.ai.node.id'] != '' OR SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'] != '')),
runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, anyIf(workflow, workflow != '') AS wf,
         min(ts) AS started, max(addNanoseconds(ts, Duration)) AS ended,
         (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(ended) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(started)) / 1e9 AS seconds,
         countIf(op = 'invoke_workflow') AS segments,
         multiIf(segments = 0, 'In progress',
                 argMaxIf(error_type, ts, op = 'invoke_workflow') = 'canceled', 'Cancelled',
                 argMaxIf(failed, ts, op = 'invoke_workflow'), 'Failed', 'Succeeded') AS outcome,
         countIf(is_call) AS calls, countIf(is_tool) AS tools,
         sumIf(in_tok, is_call) AS run_in, sumIf(out_tok, is_call) AS run_out, sumIf(cost, is_call) AS run_cost
  FROM ai WHERE run_id != '' GROUP BY run_id)
SELECT count() AS "Runs" FROM runs

panels.title: Run success rate
panels.description: Succeeded runs over finished ones (succeeded or failed), by the status of each run's last workflow segment. Cancelled runs, and runs whose workflow span is not reported yet, are neither.

runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, anyIf(workflow, workflow != '') AS wf,

panels.title: Run duration (p50)
panels.description: The median run's wall time, from its first span to the end of its last, across every segment. Time a run spent paused (an approval, a wait) is included.

panels.title: Model calls
panels.description: Model calls (gen_ai.operation.name chat, text_completion, generate_content or embeddings) in the range, in a run or not. The trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql: SELECT count() AS "Model calls" FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']
panels.trendSql: SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, count() AS "Model calls" FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Input and output tokens of the range's model calls (gen_ai.usage.input_tokens + output_tokens). The trend is each UTC day's.
panels.sql: SELECT sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']) + toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])) AS "Tokens" FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']
panels.trendSql: SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']) + toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])) AS "Tokens" FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Prompt cache hit ratio
panels.description: Input tokens read from the provider's prompt cache over all input tokens. Providers that report no cache reads count as 0.
panels.sql: SELECT round(sum(toUInt64OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read_input_tokens']))) / nullIf(sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])), 0), 4) AS "Cache hit" FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']

panels.title: Gateway-reported cost (USD)
panels.description: The sum of the cost the provider or gateway reported on each model call (forge.ai.cost.usd), in US dollars. Calls with no reported cost (a provider called directly with your own key) add nothing, and a range with none shows no figure. Never an estimate, and not an invoice.
panels.sql: SELECT round(sum(toFloat64OrNull(if(SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'] != '', SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'], SpanAttributes['reliant.cost_usd']))), 4) AS "Reported cost" FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']

panels.title: Runs by outcome

runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, anyIf(workflow, workflow != '') AS wf,
         min(ts) AS started, max(addNanoseconds(ts, Duration)) AS ended,

panels.title: Model calls by provider
panels.description: Model calls each UTC day by provider (gen_ai.provider.name).
panels.sql:
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system']) AS provider, count() AS "Calls"
FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']
GROUP BY day, provider ORDER BY day, provider

panels.title: Tokens by day
panels.description: Each UTC day's input tokens (less cache reads), cache reads and output tokens.
panels.sql:
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day,
       sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])) - least(sum(toUInt64OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read_input_tokens']))), sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']))) AS "Input",
       sum(toUInt64OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read_input_tokens']))) AS "Cache read", sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])) AS "Output"
FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
